briefdescription.para: Solve the variable value dataflow problem, for a single lexical scope.

detaileddescription.para: Uses the algorithm from the file comment to resolve control flow joins using PHI placement and value propagation. Reads the locations of machine values from the MInLocs and MOutLocs arrays (see buildMLocValueMap) and reads the variable values transfer function from AllTheVlocs. Live-in and Live-out variable values are stored locally, with the live-ins permanently stored to Output once a fixedpoint is reached. VarsWeCareAbout contains a collection of the variables in Scope that we should be tracking. AssignBlocks contains the set of blocks that aren't in DILoc's scope, but which do contain DBG_VALUEs, which VarLocBasedImpl tracks locations through.
